changeSet.sql: create or alter function [dbo].[UserAssetPermissions] ( @ResourceID int, @AssetTypeID int ) returns table as return ( select [Permissions] as PermissionsBitMask, AssetID, AssetTypeID from dbo.ResponsibilitySummary where AssetTypeID = @AssetTypeID and ResourceID = @ResourceID and ApplyToType = 0 union all select [Permissions] as PermissionsBitMask, A.ID as AssetID, A.AssetTypeID from dbo.ResponsibilitySummary S inner join dbo.Asset A on A.AssetTypeID = S.AssetTypeID and A.ID = @AssetTypeID and S.ResourceID = @ResourceID and S.ApplyToType = 1 union all select A.PermissionsBitMask, A.AssetID, A.AssetTypeID from dbo.AssetType T cross apply ( select ResourceID, IsAdministrator from reporting.Global_Resource where ResourceID = @ResourceID and IsAdministrator = 0 ) R cross apply GetAssetsOfDefaultPermissions(@ResourceID, @AssetTypeID, T.DefaultPermissions, R.IsAdministrator, 0) A where T.ID = @AssetTypeID and T.DefaultPermissions = 0 )
